title: Pressing Trigger Pass (Bait and Press)
content: A pressing trigger pass deliberately invites the opponent to press by playing a pass to a slightly isolated player in a position where the team has pre-organised the press response. The isolated player receives under pressure, and the moment the opponent commits their pressing players, the team springs the press trap — the receiving player plays out quickly to a free teammate who is positioned to receive, and the pressing opponent is now out of position. This is a deliberate tactical move: the 'bait' player must have the composure to receive under pressure and execute a clean exit pass. Requires high off-ball synchronisation — the free player must already be in the exit position before the triggering pass is played.
